addon.ctf-toolkit.conv_placeholder: Paste text or an encoded string...
addon.ctf-toolkit.magic_none: Nothing readable came out of any decoder. Try the Ciphers tab.
addon.ctf-toolkit.brute_none: No single-byte key gives readable text.
addon.ctf-toolkit.ident_placeholder: Paste a hash to identify it...
addon.ctf-toolkit.ident_none: Doesn't match a common hash format.
addon.ctf-toolkit.ident_match: Matches the {algo} of your input above
addon.ctf-toolkit.jwt_unverified: The signature is shown but NOT verified - decoding a token doesn't prove it's genuine.
addon.ctf-toolkit.file_drop: Drop a file here or click to choose
addon.ctf-toolkit.file_local: It's analysed in your browser and never uploaded.
addon.ctf-toolkit.file_truncated: Only the first {mb} MB were analysed.
addon.ctf-toolkit.file_ext_mismatch: The extension .{ext} doesn't obviously match the detected type - worth a closer look.
addon.ctf-toolkit.file_trailing: {extra} bytes follow the end of the {kind} image (offset {end}). Data is often hidden there.
addon.ctf-toolkit.freq_english: close to English or another single-alphabet cipher (Caesar, Atbash, substitution)
addon.ctf-toolkit.freq_flat: flat - looks polyalphabetic (e.g. Vigenère) or random
addon.ctf-toolkit.freq_between: in between - short text or a mixed cipher
addon.ctf-toolkit.freq_legend: Bars: your text. Outlined markers: typical English.
addon.ctf-toolkit.title: Toolkit
addon.ctf-toolkit.intro: Handy tools for CTF challenges. Everything runs locally in your browser - nothing you paste or open here leaves this window.
addon.ctf-toolkit.meta.name: CTF Toolkit
addon.ctf-toolkit.meta.description: Adds a Toolkit tab with local tools for CTF players: a converter with automatic multi-layer decoding, classical ciphers (Caesar, Vigenère, XOR, rail fence), hashing and hash identification, a JWT decoder, a file inspector and frequency analysis. Nothing leaves the browser.
